verdict.rationale: Qodo documents an official Agentic Toolbox CLI that installs locally and gives coding agents Qodo-managed skills, such as reviewing changes before opening a PR and retrieving applicable rules and standards (docs-32, docs-44, docs-5, docs-7, probe-4). Hands-on community reports back this up: one user updated to the latest Qodo Command CLI and praised its rwx permission toggle, and others discuss it as a benchmarked CLI agent. Missing for 10: a detailed command reference or depth of CLI documentation in the evidence, and clear confirmation that the community-tested Qodo Command CLI is the same tool as the currently documented Agentic Toolbox CLI.
